title: Universal property of a sharp affine monoid spectrum
statement: Let $T$ be a topological space with a sheaf $\mathcal A$ of commutative monoids whose stalks are sharp (their only invertible element is $0$). Let $P$ be a fine sharp monoid, and let $S(P)=(\operatorname{Spec}_{\mathrm{mon}}P,\overline{\mathcal M}_P)$ be its monoid spectrum with the sharpened structure sheaf [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup]. A morphism $(T,\mathcal A)\to S(P)$ means a continuous map $h:T\to\operatorname{Spec}_{\mathrm{mon}}P$ with a sheaf homomorphism $h^{-1}\overline{\mathcal M}_P\to\mathcal A$ whose stalk maps are local, meaning that the inverse image of the units is the units. Pullback of the canonical sections of $P$ gives a natural bijection $\operatorname{Hom}((T,\mathcal A),S(P))\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{Mon}}(P,\Gamma(T,\mathcal A))$. This bijection is natural in $(T,\mathcal A)$ and in $P$.

source.place: Expose VIII, Lemma 3.1.8(ii) and proof, printed p.99; definitions 3.1.3 and 3.1.6, printed pp.98--99. Restricted to fine sharp P.

proof.text: Fix $\varphi:P\to\Gamma(T,\mathcal A)$. Apply [lem-trf-sharp-section-basic-chart-data] to obtain the continuous prime map $h_\varphi$ and the restriction-compatible $\theta_a$, including their numerator formula. These satisfy every hypothesis of [lem-trf-affine-fan-basic-map-local-lift], so they extend to a sheaf map with local stalk maps. Denote the resulting morphism by $G(\varphi)$. For $a=0$, $D(0)$ is the whole spectrum and the numerator formula gives $\Phi(G(\varphi))(p)=\varphi(p)$ for every $p\in P$, where $\Phi$ is pullback of canonical sections.

source.place: Expose VIII, Lemma 3.1.8(ii), proof using (i), printed p.99; assemble basic charts and local sheaf lift

proof.text: For any local morphism $g$, [lem-trf-affine-fan-canonical-section-rigidity] identifies its point map and each basic-open sheaf map from $\Phi(g)$. Step 1 gives $\Phi(G(\Phi(g)))=\Phi(g)$, so the rigidity lemma gives $G(\Phi(g))=g$. Together with $\Phi(G(\varphi))=\varphi$, this proves both inverse identities and hence the claimed bijection.

source.place: Expose VIII, Lemma 3.1.8(ii), proof using (i), printed p.99; assemble inverse identities from point and section rigidity

proof.text: For a local morphism $k:(T',\mathcal A')\to(T,\mathcal A)$, composition of stalk maps is local, since inverse images of units compose [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup]. Pullback of sections composes with the sheaf maps, so for every $p\in P$ one has $\Phi(g\circ k)(p)=\Gamma(k)(\Phi(g)(p))$. Thus $\Phi(g\circ k)=\Gamma(k)\circ\Phi(g)$, proving naturality in the source.

source.place: Expose VIII, Lemma 3.1.8(ii), proof using (i), printed p.99; naturality under composition of source pullbacks

proof.text: Let $u:P\to Q$ be a homomorphism of fine sharp monoids. By [lem-trf-affine-fan-localization-sections] with $a=0$, $\Gamma(S(Q),\overline{\mathcal M}_Q)=Q/Q^\times=Q$, since $Q$ is sharp; this identification sends the canonical section of $q$ to $q$. The same lemma identifies its stalks with localizations modulo units; by the sharpening definition [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup] these are sharp: an invertible class has representatives whose sum is a unit, so each representative is a unit and the class is zero. Step 1 applied to the canonical-section map composed with $u$ gives $S(u):S(Q)\to S(P)$ with $S(u)^*(p)=u(p)$. Any other local morphism with these pullbacks equals $S(u)$ by Step 2. For $g:(T,\mathcal A)\to S(Q)$, composition of pullbacks yields $\Phi(S(u)\circ g)(p)=\Phi(g)(u(p))$, hence $\Phi(S(u)\circ g)=\Phi(g)\circ u$. The identity of $S(P)$ pulls $p$ back to $p$, as does $S(\mathrm{id}_P)$. For $v:Q\to R$, $S(u)\circ S(v)$ pulls $p$ back to $v(u(p))$, just as $S(v\circ u)$ does; [lem-trf-affine-fan-canonical-section-rigidity] therefore identifies these local morphisms. This gives functoriality of $S$ and naturality in $P$.

source.place: Expose VIII, Lemma 3.1.8(ii), proof using (i), printed p.99; naturality in the monoid and functoriality by canonical pullbacks

lean.statement: theorem affine_hom_universal (P : Type u) [CommMonoid P] (hP : IsFine P) (sP : IsSharp P) : (∀ (T : SheafedSpace CommMonCat.{u}), (∀ x : T, IsSharp (stalk T.presheaf x)) → Function.Bijective (fun f : {f : T ⟶ affine P // IsLocalMorphism f} ↦ affinePullback f.val)) ∧ (∀ (T T' : SheafedSpace CommMonCat.{u}), (∀ x : T, IsSharp (stalk T.presheaf x)) → (∀ x : T', IsSharp (stalk T'.presheaf x)) → ∀ (k : {k : T' ⟶ T // IsLocalMorphism k}) (f : {f : T ⟶ affine P // IsLocalMorphism f}), affinePullback (k.val ≫ f.val) = (SheafedSpace.Γ.map k.val.op).hom.comp (affinePullback f.val)) ∧ (∀ (Q : Type u) [CommMonoid Q], IsFine Q → IsSharp Q → ∀ (v : P →* Q), ∃! g : {g : affine Q ⟶ affine P // IsLocalMorphism g}, affinePullback g.val = (affineSection Q).comp v ∧ ∀ (T : SheafedSpace CommMonCat.{u}), (∀ x : T, IsSharp (stalk T.presheaf x)) → ∀ (f : {f : T ⟶ affine Q // IsLocalMorphism f}), affinePullback (f.val ≫ g.val) = (affinePullback f.val).comp v)
